title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards — State Cash-Out Schedule, Consolidation and Transferability
content:
Small remaining balances on Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards are paid out in cash on request only where state law requires it. This schedule records, per card kind, whether a cash-out is available at all, the balance below which it is made, the states whose law requires it, whether the balance can be moved onto another card of the holder, and whether the card can be given to another person.

## States whose law requires cash-out of small balances

California (CA), Colorado (CO), Maine (ME), Montana (MT), New Jersey (NJ), Oregon (OR), Rhode Island (RI), Vermont (VT) and Washington (WA) — nine states.

## Schedule by card kind

| Card kind | Cash-out available | Cash-out made for balances below | States in which cash-out is made | Balance can be consolidated onto another card of the holder | Card can be given to another person |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | $10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | Yes | Yes |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Yes | $10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | Yes | Yes |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Yes | $10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | Yes | Yes |
| Registry Reward Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | No |
| Corporate Gift Card | Yes | $10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | Yes | Yes |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | No |

## Notes

- The cash-out threshold is a strict "below": a hypothetical balance of $9.99 is below $10.00; a balance of exactly $10.00 is not.
- The Registry Reward Card and the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card have no cash-out, cannot be consolidated, and cannot be given to another person; on every other kind all three are available, the cash-out only in the nine listed states.
